name: EBL Patterning HSQ
body:
Dose: 300 µC/cm² (cold development 0 °C)
Beam current: 1 nA
Beam step size: 2 nm
Field size: 500um to 1000um
Field overlap: Depends on the component, usually 10-50um
Field needs to be controlled for following line.
